ref.substituent_description: 1,2,4-Triazol-3-one ring: N1 carries a 4-chlorophenyl (Cl para to the N attachment), C(=O) between N1 and ring NH, ring C=N bonded to N2; the C=N carbon bears an exocyclic NH (H drawn below N) linked to a benzene ring carrying CO2H para to the NH.
ref.notes: Typeset. Double bonds: 3 + 3 in the benzene rings, 1 C=O, 1 ring C=N.

wrong.substituent_description: Left benzene ring (circle): Cl on the left vertex and the bond to triazolone N1 on the upper-right vertex, separated by one ring carbon (meta, 1,3). Triazolone ring N1-C(=O)-NH-C(=N-N1)-: the C=N carbon bears an exocyclic NH (H below N) linked to a second benzene ring (circle) with CO2H para to the NH.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Left benzene ring is irregularly drawn and the N1 bond appears to continue the ring's upper edge; the meta relationship is still clear from the vertex order
wrong.notes: Handwritten, black ink. Double bonds: C=O and ring C=N.

correct.substituent_description: Left benzene ring (circle) has Cl and triazolone N1 on opposite vertices (para, 4-chlorophenyl). Triazolone N1-C(=O)-NH-C(=N-N1): the C=N carbon bears an exocyclic NH (H below N) to a second benzene ring (circle) with CO2H para to the NH.
correct.notes: Handwritten, black ink. Double bonds: C=O and ring C=N. Cl written in cursive (Cl).

errors_in_wrong.description: The reference has Cl para (1,4) to the triazolone N1 attachment on the chlorophenyl ring (4-chlorophenyl); the wrong drawing places Cl meta (1,3) to the N1 attachment (Cl on the left vertex, N1 bond from the upper-right vertex, one carbon between them), giving a 3-chlorophenyl isomer.

review_notes: Wrong drawing puts Cl meta instead of para to the triazolone N on the chlorophenyl ring; the corrected drawing restores para and otherwise matches the reference. Both handwritten versions draw benzene rings as circles instead of alternating double bonds (same compound; not counted as an error).
